{{Quote|There was a struggle here. Battle droids and trooper armor--but no bodies.|The clone trooper|<ref name="what goes up" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' was under the command of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] around during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He accompanied Secura and her [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] to the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Time/Legends|year]] of the war. Previously, a detachment of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] had been sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in order to root out a base set up by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, contact with the clones was lost, not only with the clones, but with the confederate base as well. Landing a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] at the Confederate base, the group was unable to find much of the clones, though they found many destroyed [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. The clone trooper walked out on his own and soon found the remains of the clone trooper detachment. The clone deduced that a struggle had taken place, but that the droids and clones may have not been fighting each other. The clone pointed out the absence of any bodies, and all that remained of the clones was the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that they had been wearing. Secura ordered Bly to secure the area while she would set out to find the cause of the attack. With the help of native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], she discovered that a [[Beast in the Mouth of the Mountain|monster]] was responsible for the destruction. Secura set out to kill the monster and succeeded. She returned to the clone troopers, wondering aloud why the Confederate armies were building so many remote bases. She figured that they would report the Endor investigation after their [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|mission to]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="what goes up" />
